System apps are apps that come pre-installed with your device.

UniCanta is an open source uninstaller app that uses Shizuku to remove system and user apps. It allows you to debloat your device as you wish, no PC required.

Special thanks to %1$s.
UniCanta would't be the same without their work.
Keeps badges and descriptions up to date.

This app provides app removal recommendations based on third-party information. These recommendations are informational in nature and do not guarantee safety or compatibility with your specific device. Uninstalling system apps can cause unexpected issues, including but not limited to: loss of functionality, system instability, device bootloops, data loss, etc. The developer of this app is not responsible for any damage done to your device resulting from following the recommendations provided.
By clicking "Accept", you agree to use this app at your own risk.
UniCanta can anonymously report which system packages you uninstall, whether your phone restarted fine afterwards, and whether you reinstalled them. This builds community safety scores for packages.

Access to the USB device was denied. On Linux, browsers need permission to open USB devices: install udev rules for your phone (e.g. the android-udev-rules package), then unplug it and plug it back in.
Access to the USB device was denied. On Windows, the phone's ADB interface needs a WinUSB driver: install it with Zadig, then unplug the phone and plug it back in.

The device is busy: another program on this computer has claimed it. On Linux this is often ModemManager, an adb server, or a file-transfer (MTP) monitor. Stop them (e.g. sudo systemctl stop ModemManager), unplug the phone and plug it back in, then pick it again.
